zh: 市場預料聯儲局下周加息
美股三指數結束四日跌勢
work.en: U.S. headline CPI rose 3.4% year-on-year in August, boosting market expectations for a 25-basis-point rate hike next week to over 86%. Despite persistent inflation, U.S. stock indices ended a four-day losing streak as oil prices eased, with the Dow Jones closing up 509 points.

zh: 港銀公會與德勤發布藍圖報告
九成九受訪銀行持正面態度
對香港金融中心地位表達支持
work.en: The Hong Kong Association of Banks and Deloitte jointly released the Banking 2030 blueprint report. The survey reveals that 99% of interviewed banks maintain a positive outlook on the future development and financial status of Hong Kong's banking sector.

zh: 本港多間銀行更新港元定存優惠
建行亞洲定存利率最高達6.88厘
中銀及恒生亦提供高息特惠
work.en: Major banks in Hong Kong have updated their promotional rates for Hong Kong dollar fixed deposits. China Construction Bank offers rates up to 6.88%, while Bank of China and Hang Seng Bank provide promotional rates up to 5.00% and 6.00% respectively.

smalltalk_hk.headline: Mainland condiment giant Haitian Flavouring completes acquisition of Hong Kong's Amoy Food
smalltalk_hk.body: Mainland condiment leader Haitian Flavouring has completed its acquisition of Amoy Food to accelerate its global strategic expansion. This transaction marks another ownership change for the iconic Hong Kong brand.

smalltalk_sg.headline: Singapore tests cross-bank AI to flag scam accounts in near real time
smalltalk_sg.body: Singapore is testing a cross-bank artificial intelligence system designed to flag scam accounts in near real time across financial institutions. The initiative aims to enhance early scam detection and protect retail banking clients from financial fraud.

personal_hk.headline: 沙田圍呂明才小學39人食校園午膳後疑食物中毒
personal_hk.body:
浸信會沙田圍呂明才小學39名師生周三進食滷水雞髀及長通粉後疑食物中毒。
食安中心已指示涉事午膳供應商即時暫停運作以進行徹底清潔消毒。

personal_sg.headline: Malaysian politician Syed Saddiq invites Health Minister Ong Ye Kung to October wedding
personal_sg.body:
Malaysian politician Syed Saddiq Abdul Rahman invited Singapore Health Minister Ong Ye Kung to his wedding in October.
Saddiq joked that he had upgraded bilateral relations to wedding-invitation status.
